cognitive_contract.label: Synthesize / cross-topic synthesis (National/International Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Autonomous formulation and resolution of an intermediate cross-domain bridge invariant Z connecting disparate mathematical fields to evaluate protected quantity W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to establish cross-domain invariants between roots of unity / combinatorics, Pell Diophantine geometry, or Hensel lifting without intermediate scaffolding.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the separate mathematical domain identities without providing the bridge connecting them.

slots.X: synthesizing complex roots of unity multisection filter with binomial coefficients to compute arithmetic progression binomial sums
slots.Z: discrete Fourier multisection filter with omega = exp(2pi*i/3): S = 1/3 [2^18 + omega^2(1+omega)^18 + omega(1+omega^2)^18]; (1+omega)^18 = (-omega^2)^18 = omega^36 = 1; S = (2^18 - 1)/3
slots.wrong_idea: miscalculating omega^2 + omega = 0 or attempting step-size 2 parity multisection
slots.replacement_rule: use cyclotomic filter sum_{j=0}^{m-1} omega^{j(r-k)} = m delta_{r, k mod m}; with m=3, r=1, evaluating (1+omega)^18 = 1 gives (2^18 - 1)/3 = 87381
slots.visual_job: render unit circle in complex plane showing the three cube roots of unity 1, omega, omega^2 with vectors for 1+omega and 1+omega^2; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent verification: check n=3 gives binom(3,1) = 3; formula gives (2^3 + 1)/3 = 3; check n=6 gives binom(6,1) + binom(6,4) = 6 + 15 = 21; formula gives (2^6 - 1)/3 = 63/3 = 21. For n=18, (2^18 - 1)/3 = 262143/3 = 87381. Verified.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact formulation of an international Olympiad multi-discipline synthesis challenge
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates disparate domain foundations; H2 frames bridge invariant Z without leaking W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete formal step-by-step cross-disciplinary deduction evaluating W
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student cross-topic failure or partial synthesis slip

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or textual answer in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.rule: Targeted active recall eliciting the synthesis bridge invariant before problem execution

core2a_navigation.rule: Explicit question-specific data-core-unit-id navigation hook required in DOM representation

precommit_dom_privacy.rule: Neutral buttons, no data-correct / is_correct attributes, locked details container with inert and hidden
